answer_1.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of our method through three text generation tasks: sentiment control, LM detoxification, and abstractive text summarization.
answer_1.outputs: generated text in sentiment control, detoxified text, and abstractive summaries

answer_2.quote: For summary quality evaluation, we use both the ROUGE score and the preference score calculated using the reward model.

answer_3.quote: we use the gpt-3.5-turbo model through OpenAI's API... The input prompt is structured in three segments. First, we define the task within the prompt, outlining the types of correct responses or errors the critic model should identify.
methods: few-shot prompting with task description and examples

answer_4.quote: We hired five IELTS certified raters to evaluate the quality of the generated summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Definition of the three metrics Content Preservation: Assess how well the summary captures the essential information, themes, and nuances of the original text. Factuality: Evaluate the accuracy of the information in the summary relative to the original text. Coherence: Assess the logical flow, readability, and structure of the summary.
